_comment: Measured gas of one referee step of TankLadder. The page estimates the cost of a challenge from these numbers and the weight bytes of the two entries: gas ≈ steps × (forward(challengerBytes) + forward(defenderBytes) + scenePerStep) + transactions × perTransaction. forward(B) is linear in weightBytes between the two measured points (forward.intercept + forward.perByte × B). Unit: gas. All numbers exclude the 21k base cost and the calldata.
source: contracts/scripts/ladder-gas.mjs — TankLadder with the spec config on anvil 1.8.0 --network monad (30M block limit), with a 中 network of 39,840 B and a 大 network of 216,864 B. The gas of a step depends on the weight bytes and the active inputs, not on the training. stepsPerEpisode comes from networks of template revision 13. The networks in ladder/data/artifacts (the scene of revision 16) play about 38 steps per episode on average.

pairs._comment: challenger-defender. loopStep: gas per step inside a full 30M play transaction. singleStep: one step alone in its own transaction (cold access, load, save, Steps event). stepsPerTransaction: steps that one 30M transaction plays with the 2M reserve. worstCaseTransactions: a 600-step challenge.
